name: Downhole safety valve
description: Fail-safe downhole barrier that isolates reservoir fluids at surface if wellhead/tree containment is lost.

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Downhole safety valve, Operation section
specifications.value: uni-directional flapper valve which opens downwards; hydraulic pressure from surface opens against a spring; loss of pressure closes it

specifications.metric: minimum setting depth below mudline (MMS regulation)
specifications.basis: Wikipedia Downhole safety valve, Positioning section, citing MMS regulations

specifications.value: hydraulically controlled from surface via a control line linked to a well control panel

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Downhole safety valve, Legal requirement section
specifications.value: not a direct legal requirement; 1974 Health & Safety at Work Act requires prevention of uncontrolled release, so DHSVs are company policy for many UKCS operators

gaps.what: OEM DHSV pressure ratings, bore sizes and metallurgy
gaps.next_action: Fetch OEM subsurface safety valve product sheets.

applications: Fail-safe downhole barrier that isolates reservoir fluids at surface if wellhead/tree containment is lost.
